takeaways: USDA's latest retail beef feature report shows ground beef (80-89%, 1-2 lb) advertised at a $5.75/lb national weighted average, down from $6.27 the week before, with a 95.6% feature rate.

Thanksgiving meal-deal wars are on: Walmart $35, Aldi under $39, Food Lion under $40, Price Chopper/Market 32 under $40, Wegmans under $40 (8 people). The baskets are turkey-led, with no beef featured.
Ahold Delhaize (Food Lion/Giant) cut its 2026 outlook after an October cyberattack hit online operations; Food Lion still led U.S. online growth above 20% in Q3.
The DOJ probe of eight retailers' beef pricing (opened in September) is the backdrop for any beef price talk; I found no new development this week.
I found no fresh verified cocoa or chocolate retail pricing news this week.

items.text: Holiday Meal Basket serves 10 for $35 ($3.50 per person), 26 items, through Dec. 24; the Butterball turkey is cited at 97 cents/lb.
In a WSMV (Nashville) check of eight Thanksgiving side items, Walmart totaled $19.95 versus Aldi $14.78.
In the WSMV side-item check Kroger totaled $24.50, or $19.55 with a Kroger Plus card.
Promoting a 'feast for a few' with fully cooked turkey breast or rotisserie chicken and single-slice pies; no prices given.
Thanksgiving meal for 10 under $39 with a 16-lb turkey, no loyalty card needed, through Nov. 25.
Lowest total ($14.78) in WSMV's eight-item side-dish comparison.
Thanksgiving meal for 8 under $40 (under $5 per person) with a 13-lb Shady Brook turkey; frozen turkey promo Nov. 8-22.
Food Lion's Thanksgiving Meal Deal serves 10 for under $40 at last year's price, Nov. 11-26, with an MVP card. No beef item in the bundle.
GIANT is running a free-turkey program for 400 Choice points, Nov. 6-26.
Ahold Delhaize's U.S. Q3 sales rose 1.1% at constant rates. An October cyberattack hit online operations and the company cut its 2026 EPS outlook; Food Lion led U.S. online growth above 20%.
Thanksgiving feast for 10 under $40 (under $4 per person) from Nov. 1 through Thanksgiving with an AdvantEdge card; cooked meals could be ordered Nov. 2-16 for Nov. 24-26 pickup.
Winn-Dixie has a heat-and-serve holiday deli meal at $39.99 through Dec. 29 and a $14.99 rotisserie chicken meal for four.
Hy-Vee lowered its holiday meal deal to under $35 for 10 and has premade holiday meals for 2-12 people.
FMI survey: 45% of shoppers are very or extremely concerned about holiday food prices (up 8 points) and 72% call loyalty programs essential to budgeting.

USDA feature report: ground beef 80-89%, 1-2 lb, advertised at $5.75/lb (5,081 stores) vs $6.27 prior week and $6.32 a year ago; overall feature rate 95.6%. The report's date stamps are inconsistent (Nov 9 vs Nov 13).
items.source: USDA AMS weekly grocery beef feature report

items.text: DOJ's beef price probe covers Kroger, Walmart, Publix, Albertsons, Aldi, Ahold Delhaize, Costco and Amazon; no new development found this week.
Background only, from March: cocoa futures were about $3,100/t versus over $6,000 at the end of 2025, while U.S. chocolate shelf prices were up 14.4% in early 2026. I found no newer verified data.

talkingPoints: Holiday featuring is turkey and meal-bundle driven, so ask distributors whether beef is getting any December feature support at their retail accounts.
Ground beef ad prices dipped week over week in USDA's feature data; ask whether end users are using that to drive volume.
Shoppers are price-anxious and loyalty-driven, so ask which value-tier deli and prepared items distributors' chains are pushing.
Ahold Delhaize's cyber disruption hit online sales; ask Food Lion/Giant-supplying distributors whether it affected order patterns.
